facts.text: SIUE requires all first-time, full-time students who finished high school within the last 12 months to live on campus unless commuting under 60 miles from home.

sources.title: University Housing - SIUE
sources.quote: All first-time, full-time students who graduated high school within the last 12 months and are not commuting less than 60 miles from their legal parent/guardian home address must live on campus.
